title: Allow Posting Date Formula
summary: Business Central now supports date formulas for allowed posting dates in General Ledger Setup and User Setup, eliminating the common first-of-month panic when users cannot post transactions outside their allowed date range. This feature allows flexible, formula-based date restrictions that adjust automatically based on the current date.
key_points: Date formulas can be set for Allowed Posting From and Allowed Posting To dates
Feature is available in both General Ledger Setup and User Setup
Replaces previous workarounds like custom job queue entries or sign-in processes
Enables scenarios like opening only the current month based on today's date or allowing specific users to post in prior months

quotes.text: Business Central now has a feature to define Date Formulas for the Allowed Posting From and Allowed Posting To.
quotes.why_it_matters: This is the core feature announcement, explaining that dynamic date formulas replace static date ranges

quotes.text: With this you can set date formulas to open the current month only based on todays date (as an example).
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates a practical use case showing how the feature solves the first-of-month posting problem
